title: different choices from 2 or more identical events on the map

posts.author: Robrambo890
posts.body:
Hi everyone, I have a big problem that I can't solve
I will try to make myself understood as best I can.
I'm creating a game similar to the very famous Stardew Valley,
so being a simulation game, you can also create objects and materials in mine.
Without beating around the bush, let's get to the point,
1 Create the object from the menu and place it on the map,
the object in question is a "Fermentation Barrel"
2 Once the barrel is placed on the map, when the player approaches and presses the interact button, 4 choices will appear
3 Once you have made your choice, the barrel will produce the selected item after a certain number of days
4 Now the problem is that as long as I have a barrel positioned everything works perfectly but when I place a second one, the choice made for the first barrel also applies to the second even though the player has not selected any choice on the second.
How to solve this problem?
I'm using RPG Maker MZ

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
Robrambo890 said:
How to solve this problem?
Click to expand...
It's impossible to say because you haven't shown us screenshots of your events.
It sounds like you're using the same variable/switch on each of the events, so obviously each one would do the same thing. If you want the events to do different things, they need to set and check different variables/switches.

posts.author: AquaEcho
posts.body: Each object needs an individual timer and right now both of your objects are sharing a global timer.

posts.author: Robrambo890
posts.body:
Thanks for the replies guys,
Unfortunately, since it is an object that can be crafted, it is necessarily a single event, but I solved it because I noticed that it doesn't give me any problems with the automatic control switches.
so I put a plugin that allows me to have more than 4 automatic control switches.
